_comment: The read-only open path spans a Worker, a pipeline package and three files in apps/web. Before this fixture, the two app-side files that render an opened project (native-project-view.ts, NativeProjectPanel.tsx) classified as unknown_runtime_surface, so a change to how a project is displayed - which level, which walls, whether the read-only reason is shown - could avoid selecting browser_native_open entirely.
